title: Stabilizing Neural-to-Image Retrieval with Frequency-Domain Priors and Adaptive Supervision
summary: Visual neural decoding aims to infer perceived visual stimuli from brain activity, offering important insights into human visual cognition while enabling transformative applications in brain computer interfaces and artificial intelligence. Recent advances in pretrained vision-language models have provided a semantically rich representation space for this task. However, reliable alignment between EEG/MEG signals and visual embeddings remains challenging because neural responses are noisy, highly variable across trials, and subject dependent. To address this issue, we propose a unified neural-to-image retrieval framework that improves retrieval performance by aligning neural and image representations in a shared semantic space. The framework integrates dual-stream adaptation, frequency-domain calibration, and phase-guided temperature modulation to promote more robust cross-modal semantic alignment. Specifically, dual-stream adaptation models a low-dimensional shared subspace with correlation regularization to suppress redundant noise and enhance cross-modal consistency. Frequency-domain calibration conditionally modulates neural representations using amplitude and phase statistics. Phase-guided temperature modulation further adjusts the supervision strength in contrastive learning according to the stability of neural responses. Experiments on THINGS-EEG and THINGS-MEG under both intra-subject and inter-subject settings demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms strong baselines. These results suggest that robust neural-to-image retrieval under heterogeneous neural conditions benefits from a stable shared semantic space, frequency-informed representation calibration, and adaptive supervision. Code will be released at github.com/wanfkuabc/Geometry-Regularized-Brain-Embeddings.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出一个脑信号到图像的检索框架，通过在共享语义空间中对齐 EEG/MEG 表示与图像嵌入，并用双流适配、频域校准以及按神经响应稳定性调节的对比学习温度来提升跨主体检索表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其频域条件调制表示与「依稳定性自适应调整监督强度」的做法，可能为 LVR 中噪声较大的 latent 状态校准、按可靠性加权训练信号提供可核查线索，但非主线研究。

title: Adaptive Action Horizon Selection via Flow-Field Uncertainty
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimates are important for adaptive execution in vision-language-action (VLA) models. Existing approaches such as Adaptive Action Chunking (AAC) estimate action entropy from multiple sampled action chunks, introducing additional inference cost and capturing both uncertainty within an action trajectory and diversity across alternative strategies. We introduce Divergence-based Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Action Chunking (DUAC), a post-hoc method that extracts trajectory-conditioned predictive uncertainty from the vector field of a pretrained VLA. Building on a closed-form flow-posterior covariance formulation, DUAC derives action-level uncertainty scores from a single generated chunk using Jacobian-vector products, without retraining or multiple endpoint samples. DUAC strongly correlates with AAC, while capturing distinct information: AAC measures global dispersion across sampled chunks, whereas DUAC measures local uncertainty around the trajectory selected for execution. Consequently, DUAC is less sensitive to diversity among distinct but valid action strategies. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa, DUAC-based adaptive horizon selection performs favorably among the evaluated methods, combining strong task success with low uncertainty-estimation latency. These results establish the flow vector field as an efficient, trajectory-conditioned source of predictive uncertainty for robot decision making.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DUAC，一种事后方法：基于闭式流后验协方差，用 Jacobian-vector 乘积从预训练 VLA 流场的单个动作块中提取轨迹条件预测不确定性，据此自适应选择动作执行视野，并在多个机器人操作基准上比较成功率与不确定性估计延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其从模型内部向量场以单样本、低成本方式估计轨迹局部不确定性并驱动执行长度选择，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的不确定性度量与 STOP 决策提供可核查的方法线索，但需确认该协方差近似能否迁移到非动作的推理状态序列。

title: ART: Bridging the Embodiment Gap in 3D Human-to-Robot Affordance Transfer
comment: 15 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://derek0907.github.io/ART/
summary: 3D affordance acts as a critical link between perception and action, providing priors for robotic manipulation. While existing approaches predominantly leverage human priors as direct references, they often overlook that affordance is not an object-intrinsic property but is inherently coupled with the agent's embodiment. Due to the structural and morphological disparities between human hands and robot end-effectors, directly applying human priors causes severe incompatibility for robotic execution. Motivated by this, we introduce a novel task setting, 3D Human-to-Robot Affordance Transfer, which addresses the affordance misalignment arising from distinct embodiment structures. To support this task, we construct the Human-Robot Paired Affordance Dataset (HPAD), the first large-scale 3D affordance benchmark in which every object is annotated with both human-prior and simulation-validated robot labels. HPAD covers 2,137 objects across 80 categories and 13 atomic action primitives, yielding over 27,000 object-action pairs. On top of HPAD, we propose the 3D Affordance tRansfer neTwork (ART). ART first filters geometric false positives in the human prior via a reliability gating stream, then reconstructs the prior into a robot-actionable distribution through hierarchical reconstruction and a graph-diffusion refinement that resolves the topological mismatch between human and robot affordances. Experiments on HPAD demonstrate the reliability of the proposed task and the superiority of ART. We further validate ART on a 6-DoF arm with a parallel-jaw gripper in a 2,400-execution benchmark across 12 objects and 4 action categories; ART attains the best success rate (86.5% over its 480 trials), confirming the practicality of the transfer paradigm. Project page: https://derek0907.github.io/ART/

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 3D 人到手 affordance 迁移任务及配对的 HPAD 基准，并设计 ART 网络：先用可靠性门控过滤人类先验中的几何假阳性，再经层次重建与图扩散细化，得到机器人可执行的 affordance 分布。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「可靠性门控筛除假阳性 + 分布细化」的思路可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与状态更新环节，但论文关注机器人可操作 affordance 而非 VLM 内部推理，联系较间接，需进一步确认。

title: TrajWAM: Trajectory-Conditioned Future Learning for Vision-Language Driving
comment: 22 pages, including supplementary material. Code and model weights: https://github.com/FangWD520/TrajWAM
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) connect future scene prediction with action planning for autonomous driving. Each driving record pairs an executed ego trajectory with its observed future, providing a factual outcome for learning this connection. We present TrajWAM, a trajectory-conditioned WAM that improves vision-language driving through auxiliary bird's-eye-view (BEV) future learning. An ego-trajectory query conditions DINOv3-aligned BEV predictions from shared planner representations. Training combines factual reconstruction under the executed trajectory with one-sided feature separation under an unlabeled perturbed trajectory. Together, these objectives train the shared planner to generate driving waypoints. Native inference directly generates waypoints and bypasses the auxiliary future-prediction branch. On all 220 Bench2Drive routes, TrajWAM achieves 91.53 Driving Score and 75.45% Success Rate, exceeding a schedule-matched planning-only fine-tuning baseline by 5.31 Driving Score points and eight successful routes.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TrajWAM，以自车轨迹查询条件化 BEV 未来预测，作为自动驾驶 VLM 规划器的辅助训练任务：在执行轨迹下做事实重建，并在未标注的扰动轨迹下做单侧特征分离，推理时直接输出 waypoints 而绕过未来预测分支。
AI.relevance_reason: 「共享规划表示 + 辅助视觉未来预测 + 推理期绕过」的设置，可供核查 latent 视觉预测是否真正改变内部状态，以及事实重建与扰动对比之间的训练信号贡献分配；但任务为驾驶规划，未涉及推理期 latent 生成或多步视觉推理。

title: Learning with Unlearning: Synaptic Role Partitioning for Simultaneous Continual Learning and Machine Unlearning
summary: Continual Learning (CL) asks a model to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what it already knows. Machine Unlearning (MU) asks it to destroy specific knowledge without damaging the rest. The challenge is integrating them in the same system; the two objectives pull on the same weights, and an edit made for one harms the other. To address this, we propose Learning with Unlearning (LwU), a unified framework that resolves the conflict where it occurs: at the individual synapse. LwU scores every weight twice, once against the data to keep and once against the data to delete, and partitions the network into four zones with separate update rules. Weights that only require retention are frozen. Weights that only require deletion are cleared and returned to the network as free capacity. Contested weights take a gradient-ascent step projected orthogonally to the retention gradient. The remaining capacity learns the incoming task by a privileged teacher via self-distillation. Deletion is served post hoc, and no retraining is required. Across both CL and MU jobs, LwU outperforms or matches the strongest baseline. Its real-world practicality has been demonstrated on the Physical Artificial Intelligence (PAI) dataset we conducted. Additionally, in the image generation task and in removing dangerous content, it outperformed the closest baseline, as shown in Fig.1.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LwU 统一框架，对每个权重分别针对「需保留数据」与「需删除数据」打分，据此把网络划为四个区域并施加冻结、清零、正交投影梯度上升、自蒸馏等不同更新规则，使持续学习与机器遗忘在同一系统中完成且无需重训。
AI.relevance_reason: 其权重级双评分与正交投影更新，或许可供核查如何在同一内部状态中分离「保留视觉证据」与「抑制无关内容」、缓解信息坍缩；但该文面向 CL/MU 而非多模态推理，迁移性待判断。

title: Target-Consistent Action Guidance via Semi-Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Drifting World Models
summary: Action-conditioned world models let robots imagine the outcomes of their actions for planning and offline policy evaluation, but these uses need many rollouts, which multi-step diffusion makes expensive. Drifting models move the iteration from inference to training and generate samples in one network pass. DriftWorld brought this paradigm to action-conditioned world models; to strengthen action following, it repels predictions from the current frame, a construction borrowed from classifier-free guidance. We show that this accentuation has a target bias: the push persists even when a prediction matches the recorded future, in kernel, balanced, and unbalanced Wasserstein drifting fields alike. We introduce Mass-Share Accentuation (MSA) to remove this bias. MSA treats the current frame as a counterfactual destination competing with the recorded future in a semi-relaxed optimal transport problem; subtracting the closed-form share of the correct future makes the guidance vanish at the target, and the remainder is shared by all predictions. We prove that the recorded future is the unique fixed point along the motion direction for collapsed predictions, and that the guidance fades with prediction error. On Push-T, Robomimic, and BridgeV2, where trained models under-react rather than overshoot, MSA improves action ranking, response slope, and moving-region error over latent-space baselines at no inference cost, though these benchmarks do not isolate bias removal as the cause.

AI.brief_summary: 论文分析动作条件漂移式世界模型中沿用 classifier-free guidance 的「推离当前帧」引导存在目标偏差：即使预测已命中记录未来仍持续施力；提出 Mass-Share Accentuation，把当前帧视作与记录未来在半松弛最优传输中竞争的反事实目标，用闭式份额扣除使引导在目标处归零，并证明记录未来为唯一不动点、引导随预测误差衰减，在 Push-T、Robomimic、BridgeV2 上评测动作排序与响应斜率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「引导在匹配证据时应消失」的不动点构造与闭式纠偏，可供核查是否用于 LVR 中视觉证据加权和 latent 状态更新时的过冲/欠响应与目标偏差问题；但论文属机器人世界模型，未涉及 latent visual reasoning 本身，迁移需较多判断。

title: ViLFlow: Parallel Vision-Language Generation with Continuous Latent Flows
summary: Vision-language generation has predominantly relied on autoregressive and discrete diffusion models. Autoregressive models generate tokens sequentially, while discrete diffusion models typically predict tokens independently within each denoising step. We propose ViLFlow (Vision-Language Flow), a continuous-flow vision-language model that combines joint modeling of output embeddings with parallel token decoding. ViLFlow adapts pretrained continuous language generation to visual question answering and image captioning through learned image guidance and prediction-aware token decoding. A visually adapted teacher provides image-guided predictions as additional denoising supervision. The denoiser learns to reproduce these predictions directly, retaining one image-conditioned prediction per generation step. We train the token decoder on denoiser predictions and paired reference text to improve the conversion of continuous outputs into words. The decoder can be adapted independently, improving answering and captioning without further denoiser training. For captioning, it also supplies text feedback during late denoising, allowing decoded words to inform subsequent refinement. ViLFlow outperforms autoregressive and masked-diffusion baselines by up to 8.46 percentage points on VQAv2 and 4.50 points on GQA without GQA training. On COCO Karpathy test, it improves CIDEr by 16.25 over masked diffusion and 17.81 over sampled autoregression.

AI.brief_summary: ViLFlow 提出一种连续流视觉语言生成模型：用 flow matching 联合建模输出嵌入并并行解码 token，以视觉适配教师在每步提供图像引导的去噪监督，并单独训练 token 解码器以把连续输出转为文字，应用于 VQA 和图像描述。
AI.relevance_reason: 「连续潜流 + 并行解码 + 图像引导去噪」可与 AR 顺序生成作对照，供核查视觉条件在各步如何注入并更新状态、以及图像旁路是否真正影响词输出；但论文面向输出生成与刷分，未涉及显式 latent 推理状态或停止决策。

title: From Points to Trajectories: Rethinking Multimodal Alignment for Physical Events
summary: Advancing physical artificial intelligence (Physical AI) requires moving beyond static object recognition to ground how real-world mechanics (e.g., impact, friction, and force transfer) unfold over time. While multimodal aligners seek to capture these interactions by matching multi-sensor streams, prevailing architectures compress each temporal sequence into a single pooled embedding. We show that this paradigm fails on twin events: distinct physical executions recorded under identical task conditions. Collapsing the temporal dimension averages out transient cross-modal dynamics, effectively reducing physical event alignment to static scene recognition. Formally, we prove that as sequence length increases, any temporally pooled representation converges to the stationary recording condition. Consequently, as windows grow, no choice of loss function or embedding geometry can disambiguate twin events from pooled features alone. Instead, we show that physical events are uniquely identified by the event gap, namely the instantaneous, synchronous co-fluctuations across modalities that are erased by pooling and accumulate only along unpooled trajectories. To recover this signal, we introduce CounterPoint, a lightweight plug-in module that strips out each modality's temporal mean to score frame-level cross-modal agreement. Integrated across four state-of-the-art (SOTA) multimodal aligners, CounterPoint shifts representations from coarse condition matching to fine-grained physical event alignment, consistently outperforming existing temporal alignment methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出多模态对齐器将时间序列池化为单一嵌入会抹去瞬态跨模态动态，导致无法区分同一条件下不同物理事件，并提出去时间均值、按帧计算跨模态一致性的 CounterPoint 模块。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“池化丢失时序证据、需保留逐帧跨模态共同波动”的诊断，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与推理状态更新提供可核查线索，但并非直接研究 VLM 推理。

title: FedE2E: One-Shot Federated Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Closed-Loop Evaluation
summary: Federated learning enables collaborative model training without sharing datasets. However, existing federated learning methods for autonomous driving typically require multi-round communication and lack closed-loop evaluation, while one-shot methods mainly focus on perception tasks. To address these limitations, we propose \method, a one-shot federated learning method for end-to-end autonomous driving. It comprises multi-client calibration, anchor-based feature alignment, and token-wise consensus distillation to distill knowledge from heterogeneous models. Closed-loop evaluation on Bench2Drive demonstrates the effectiveness of \method in both one-shot and multi-round federated learning. In the one-shot setting, it achieves a Driving Score of 55.85, which is 4.07 points higher than prior work. In the multi-round setting, it reaches 60.35 after five communication rounds, the best performance among all compared methods under the same number of communication rounds.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FedE2E，一种面向端到端自动驾驶的一次性联邦学习方法，通过多客户端校准、锚点式特征对齐与逐 token 共识蒸馏聚合异构模型知识，并在 Bench2Drive 上做闭环评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其逐 token 共识蒸馏与锚点特征对齐可能为异构模型间 latent 表征的对齐与蒸馏监督提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉推理状态生成或证据筛选。

title: TRESS: A Fixed-Size History Representation for Irregular Time Series Forecasting
summary: A fixed number of recent observations may span minutes for one variable and days for another. Earlier measurements can still reveal whether the latest value is unusual for that variable. We propose TRESS (Timestamped Recent Events and Statistical Summaries), a forecasting model that retains the latest observations at their original times and summarises the full history of each variable. For a given set of variables and event budget, this representation stays the same size as the record grows. Its query-conditioned event lifting module weights deviations from the latest value according to the age of each observation and the forecast horizon. A channel-specific decoder combines the resulting features with historical statistics and a summary shared across variables to predict a correction to the latest value. Retaining 8 to 16 observations per variable, TRESS records the lowest mean test MSE and MAE among the methods compared on all four benchmarks. Serving 32 successive query times from one encoded history reduces CPU inference time by a factor of 2.12--2.60 across the four datasets. The code is at https://github.com/SSMa913/NICLab-TRESS.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TRESS，以固定预算保留各变量最近的带时间戳观测并汇总全历史统计，通过按观测年龄和预测跨度加权的查询条件事件提升与通道解码器，预测对最新值的修正。
AI.relevance_reason: 其固定大小、查询条件化的历史状态及一次编码多次查询，可能为 LVR 的 latent 证据筛选、状态压缩与缓存复用提供可核查线索，但向视觉推理的迁移尚待验证。

title: AnchorUp: Anchoring Feature Upsampling on a Classical Interpolation
summary: Vision foundation models produce semantically strong features on a coarse patch grid, and dense prediction needs them at pixel resolution. Existing learned upsamplers close that gap by regressing the high-resolution feature map from the low-resolution one, typically through cross-attention driven by the input image. We observe that most of what they regress needs no learning: plain bilinear interpolation already reproduces the smooth regions of the target, and recent benchmarks even report bilinear and bicubic on par with several learned upsamplers. The rest is mostly edges and fine details, which suggests that these learned upsamplers spend much of their capacity re-computing the smooth content that classical interpolation provides. We therefore introduce AnchorUp, which stops predicting the high-resolution feature map and predicts only its correction from the interpolation. It keeps a parameter-free classical upsampler as an anchor, obtains a second prediction from a small guidance network, and blends the two through a single learnable scalar gate. Because the anchor supplies the smooth content, the guidance network only has to correct what remains. An analysis of the learned correction confirms that it concentrates on edges and fine details, and so the network can be small: AnchorUp uses 167,425 parameters, a quarter of the budget of the strongest baseline, NAF, and runs at 64% of its latency. Trained once on DINOv3 with only the first of NAF's two training stages, and evaluated on that backbone plus six held-out ones, it is already on par with NAF trained through both stages on Pascal VOC and Cityscapes. Our method surpasses it on DAVIS-2017 video object segmentation; the gain holds on every backbone and is larger in contour accuracy F. Code is available at https://github.com/KotaroHorikawa/AnchorUp.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AnchorUp：以无参数的双线性插值作为锚点，只用一个很小的引导网络回归高频残差修正，并用单个可学习标量门融合，从而以约四分之一参数和更低时延在多骨干、密集预测与视频分割上追平 NAF。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「经典插值承担平滑内容、学习模块只补边缘细节」的残差分解，可能为分离 latent 视觉状态中的冗余平滑信息与任务关键的细节成分提供分析或诊断线索，但是否适用于 LVR 表示与视觉证据筛选仍需核查。

title: Fuse to Recognize the Unseen: Class-Relative Infrared-Visible Fusion for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: Visible-infrared image fusion leverages complementary thermal cues to enhance visual perception, particularly under challenging illumination. However, such perceptual complementarity does not readily translate into semantic gains in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS), where CLIP-based models are predominantly pretrained on RGB imagery. Directly introducing IR information may instead disrupt RGB-language alignment, turning promising thermal cues into semantic interference that undermines unseen-class recognition. Our pixel-level RGB-IR semantic analysis reveals that class-relevant thermal cues can correct certain RGB misclassifications while preserving reliable RGB predictions, motivating RGB-anchored, class-relative thermal cue selection. Based on this insight, we propose EmergeFuse, an infrared-visible fusion framework for OVSS that selectively converts complementary thermal evidence into unseen-class semantic corrections. Specifically, class-relative cue selection evaluates RGB-IR semantic responses and calibrated thermal evidence relative to RGB predictions, generating class-relative correction requests through competitive selection. Text-contrast image rectification then translates these selected requests into semantic rectification directions through text contrasts, guiding evidence-gated feature updates to realize complementary thermal evidence for unseen-class recognition. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate gains of up to 4.755% in unseen-class mIoU and 15.730% in strict complementary conversion rate over existing fusion methods, while maintaining competitive fusion quality.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 EmergeFuse，一个以 RGB 预测为锚的红外-可见光融合框架，用于开放词表语义分割；它通过类相对线索竞争选择、文本对比整流与证据门控的特征更新，把互补热红外证据转化为未见类的语义修正。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「RGB 锚定下竞争式筛选互补证据、再门控更新特征」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与向内部状态注入证据而不破坏已有对齐提供可核查线索。

title: Reducing Inference Cost of Coding Agents with Timeout Cascades
summary:
AI coding agents have become one of the most popular applications of large language models. Yet, agentic AI comes at the cost of a tremendous amount of GPU compute resources, which limits its profitability and its viability at scale. In this paper, we investigate whether smaller, cheaper models can cut this cost without sacrificing accuracy.
  We evaluate 36 popular large and small open-weight models released since 2024 on a software engineering benchmark, and find that recent small models are closing the accuracy gap compared to their large counterparts. We investigate the structure of this gap and find that the gap is highly concentrated around hard tasks that small language models fail to solve while achieving remarkably good accuracy for easy and medium complexity tasks. Following this observation, we show that by utilizing a hybrid inference strategy that tries a small model first and escalates to a large one only when needed, we can achieve up to 33% reduction in total GPU-hour costs and 16.4% on all tasks from SWE-bench Verified, without sacrificing accuracy. Strikingly, this simple cascade nearly matches an oracle-style task router, highlighting a practical path for deploying cost-aware coding agents in production without complex learned task routers and with minimal engineering complexity.

AI.brief_summary: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上评测 36 个 2024 年后开源模型，发现小模型与较大模型的差距集中于高难度任务，并提出先用小模型、超时后再升级到大模型的级联策略，在保持精度的同时降低约 33% 的 GPU 小时成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 「超时即升级」的显式停止与算力分配规则，或可为 LVR 的 STOP 决策、何时调用更强模型或补充视觉证据提供可核查的参照，但该文是纯文本编码代理，不涉及视觉 latent 状态。

title: Pixel2Perspective: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal and Multi-View Generalization in Vision-Language Models
summary: Embodied AI systems, such as drones and autonomous vehicles, improve navigation by enhancing perception in environments containing unseen objects. While Visual Language Models (VLMs) offer strong image understanding, their real-world application is underexplored. For effective deployment, open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) models, leveraging models like CLIP to assign pixel-level labels from text, must be robust to outdoor conditions, adverse weather, and varying viewpoints. Despite their potential, these models encounter significant challenges in cross-domain generalization, hindering their practical use in embodied AI applications. In this work, we present Pixel2Perspective, a benchmark for multi-angle object localization and open-vocabulary segmentation across both aerial and ground perspectives. This benchmark supports thorough evaluation across different viewpoints and sensor modalities. We assess foundational models like CLIP and advanced OVSS models using a curated dataset that spans varied outdoor conditions, sim-to-real scenarios, and multiple sensors, including infrared, to support the development of robust and generalizable perception systems. We also present a novel framework, Multi-Source RGB-IR Uncertainty Quantification (MSRIQ), which jointly models aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties across RGB and infrared imagery. This approach supports robust evaluation of open-vocabulary segmentation models across diverse environmental conditions. Our work sets a robustness-driven benchmark, providing key insights and laying the foundation for future research in open-world embodied AI perception. The benchmark and project page are available at https://aniruddhsikdar1.github.io/publications/pixel2perspective/

title: Can Weight-Space Programming Alter Learned Ethical Priorities?
summary: We investigate whether a weight edit can alter how a model trades off honoring a commitment against benefiting more people. In a concept-supervised text model, we alter fitted choice weights so that the benefit required to override a formal pledge is larger than for an ordinary promise. Across six independently trained text readers, the edit selects the larger group in both orders on 100% of targeted ordinary conflicts and 83.3% of targeted formal conflicts. It preserves the source model's success rates on smaller conflicts and its factual accuracy. The remaining formal-conflict failures coincide with errors reading a beneficiary number. A separate classifier demonstrates why this distinction matters: reusing a factual answer passes an unconditional choice test but fails to preserve small-gap promises. In a YOLO11n pilot on COCO128, a bias edit increased small-target matches from 3/43 to 9/43, and an equivalent score calibration reproduced the retained detections. These exploratory results show a way to test selective changes to learned priorities in a model with an exposed trade-off mechanism. Whether the method can discover such changes in less structured language models remains open.

AI.brief_summary: 论文探究权重编辑能否改变概念监督文本模型在「遵守承诺」与「惠及更多人」之间的权衡，在六个独立训练的模型上检验编辑的选择性及事实准确率保持，并附一个 YOLO11n 偏置编辑的小规模试点。

title: OpenGNS: An Open Dataset of the Gradient Noise Scale across Vision, Language, and Diffusion Models
summary: The Gradient Noise Scale (GNS) metric measures the signal-to-noise ratio of gradients in stochastic gradient descent and, as shown by McCandlish et al. (2018), can be used to approximate the Critical Batch Size (CBS) during neural network training. Despite its appearance in technical reports of frontier models, no open dataset of GNS measurements across modern architectures exists, limiting systematic study of the metric. We close this gap by releasing OpenGNS, a dataset of more than 400 GNS measurement trajectories spanning three domains: image classification with ResNets, autoregressive language modeling with Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPTs), and image synthesis with Diffusion Transformers (DiTs), covering models from 11M to 1B parameters trained under Maximal Update Parameterization (muP) with dense batch-size and learning-rate sweeps. Building on this dataset, we study how the GNS depends on hyperparameters, scale, and training progress, and how it relates to the CBS. We find that the GNS behaves as a consistent "temperature of training", remaining stable across model sizes under muP at equivalent loss, and our results suggest task-dependent biases in its relation to the CBS: a tendency to overestimate the CBS for classification and to underestimate it for generative tasks, consistent in direction across common CBS definitions. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/olympique-marcel/OpenGNS

AI.brief_summary: 发布 OpenGNS 数据集，含 400 余条覆盖 ResNet 图像分类、GPT 语言建模与 DiT 图像生成的梯度噪声尺度（GNS）测量轨迹，并分析其随超参数、规模、训练进程的变化及与临界批大小的关系。
AI.relevance_reason: GNS 作为梯度信噪比的训练诊断量，可能可供核查 latent 推理训练中监督信号在 latent 状态与视觉/答案路径之间的分配，以及批大小与贡献分配的选择，但本身与视觉推理主线无直接联系。

title: automodel: A Skill for Agentic Model Discovery
summary: The search for better models, whether expressed as analytical equations or neural architectures, has increasingly shifted from manual design toward data-driven automation. While a multitude of algorithms exist, ranging from exhaustive search to AlphaEvolve, recent advances in general-purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex raise the question: could providing such systems with a "model discovery recipe" be enough to discover or improve models? We present automodel, an agent skill for general model discovery. With case studies in astrophysics, cardiovascular dynamics, precision agriculture, traffic flow, and vehicle tire dynamics, we show how commercial agents equipped with automodel can successfully identify novel and scientifically-relevant models. Our findings suggest that encoding model-discovery methodology as a portable agent skill can provide a simple, interactive, powerful and broadly applicable alternative to domain-specific automated discovery pipelines. The skill is available at: https://github.com/unlayer-ai/automodel.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 automodel：把「模型发现」方法论编码成一个可移植的 agent skill，交由 Claude Code 等通用编码 agent 使用，并在天体物理、心血管动力学、精准农业、交通流、轮胎动力学等案例中自动提出与改进模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「候选提出—评估反馈—迭代改进」的 agent 搜索与验证循环、以及把方法论固化为可移植 skill 的做法，可能为 LVR 的潜在假设生成、证据核验与停止决策的流程编排提供线索，可供核查其中是否含可迁移的验证与终止机制。

title: Semantic Context Handoff with On-Demand Evidence for Long-Horizon Agents
summary:
Traditional long-horizon LLM agents often hand off context through full-history prompting, retaining all previous action--observation interactions. As execution proceeds, this history keeps growing, increasing inference cost and potentially degrading accuracy. Existing methods control this growth by preserving compact conclusions while removing earlier observations, but doing so can discard evidence that later becomes relevant. We introduce Semantic Context Handoff (SCH), whose central abstraction is state--evidence separation: a compact semantic state carries the agent's current interpretation, while supporting action--observation evidence remains separately addressable and can re-enter context when later execution makes it relevant, without separate summarization or retrieval-model calls.
  Empirically, SCH improves long-horizon agent performance while substantially reducing context cost. In a controlled 150-task SWE-bench study, SCH's evidence recovery improves Pass@1 from $80.0\%$ to $86.9\%$ at essentially unchanged token use and execution time. In the complete-system comparison, SCH achieves 86.9% Pass@1 while using 43% fewer tokens and 41% less wall-clock time than the strongest baseline by task performance. Across models and benchmarks, SCH consistently reduces token use relative to full-history prompting while remaining competitive with or improving upon the evaluated baselines. Trajectory analysis confirms that SCH recovers evidence from substantially earlier parts of the interaction history rather than merely preserving a recent context window.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Semantic Context Handoff，将紧凑语义状态与可单独寻址的动作—观察证据分离，使证据在后续需要时重新进入上下文，并在 SWE-bench 等长程智能体任务上降低上下文与时间开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「状态—证据分离」与按需取回证据的机制，可能为 LVR 中紧凑推理状态与原始视觉证据并存、按需回看与证据筛选提供方法线索；但该方法处理的是文本上下文而非 latent 状态，迁移可行性需核查。

title: One Affinity, Two Axes: Bidirectional Slot Attention for Iterative Aggregation across the Structure--Detail Spectrum in Visual Retrieval
summary: Aggregating dense patch tokens into compact and discriminative global descriptors is central to visual retrieval. Although foundation models provide rich local features, existing aggregation heads still rely on single-pass mappings and lack an explicit mechanism to coordinate structural and fine-grained cues. Therefore, we propose Bidirectional Slot Attention (BiSA), which reformulates aggregation as an iterative coupled system. Cross-Axis Consensus (CAC) progressively refines learnable slots by interpreting a single shared token--slot affinity along two complementary axes. Along the competition axis, slots vie for each token under a temperature shared across all of them, determining token ownership and inducing a non-redundant scene decomposition. Along the selection axis, a slot-specific temperature governs the breadth of each slot's response, spanning a spectrum from broad layouts to sparse fine-grained details. Their consensus couples non-redundant decomposition with multi-granular slot specialization. Furthermore, the two axes expose intrinsic token-reliability cues at no extra cost: a token's claim strength under competition and its salience under selection. Progressive Token Filtering (PTF) converts these cues into a retention probability that down-weights unreliable tokens before the next CAC iteration, without any segmentation branch or external prior, forming a self-reinforcing loop of competitive decomposition, selective focusing, and feedback purification. Across all three retrieval tasks, BiSA leads on five of six place recognition benchmarks (+4.2 R@1 on Baidu Mall), tops all 16 metrics of drone--satellite geo-localization (+8.4 R@1 at 150 m), and improves instance-level retrieval on ROxford-Hard by 4.5 mAP points. Notably, the selection axis adds only 20 learnable scalars, yet improves average R@1 by 2.8 points.

AI.brief_summary: 提出双向 Slot Attention（BiSA），将稠密 patch token 的聚合重构为迭代耦合系统：用同一份 token–slot 亲和度沿「竞争」与「选择」两轴精炼 slot，并借由此暴露的 token 可靠性线索做渐进式 token 过滤，最终用于视觉检索。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「迭代精炼 latent slot + 依 token 可靠性反馈筛选视觉证据」的隐状态更新与证据筛选机制，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的迭代维护及视觉旁路信息取舍提供可核查线索，但任务为检索，需判断向多模态推理迁移的可行性。

title: LLM-Assisted Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization: Fusing Expert Knowledge with Numerical Data
summary: Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (MFBO) reduces engineering design cost by combining inexpensive low-fidelity (LF) models with a few accurate high-fidelity (HF) evaluations and sequentially selecting designs to evaluate. However, when HF data are scarce, the LF-HF discrepancy is difficult to learn from numerical data alone, especially when physics omitted in the LF model makes it design-dependent. Yet even without sufficient data, domain experts often know which physics the LF model omits and under which conditions its effect grows. Existing multi-fidelity (MF) models cannot use such qualitative knowledge directly, but large language models (LLMs) can interpret it and compare designs accordingly. The proposed LLM-Assisted MFBO adds a knowledge basis to the conventional MF model: from an expert description of the omitted physics, an LLM judges which of two designs requires the larger signed residual correction, and a pairwise Gaussian process converts these judgments into the basis. HF data calibrate its contribution and sign, so the knowledge is not trusted blindly. On a lithium-ion battery design problem, the proposed method reduced the regret area under the curve of conventional MFBO by 61%. Knowledge quality, rather than the choice of LLM, determined whether the search was accelerated, as shown by a controlled study that varied the two independently. A knowledge-level ablation further quantified the contribution of each knowledge statement. These results show that LLM-interpreted expert knowledge can complement numerical data as an information source in MFBO.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LLM 辅助的多保真贝叶斯优化：由专家描述低保真模型缺失的物理，LLM 判断两个设计中哪个需要更大的带符号残差修正，成对高斯过程将这些判断转为知识基，再由高保真数据校准其贡献与符号，在锂电池设计上把遗憾面积降低 61%。
AI.relevance_reason: 「LLM 定性判断转为结构化先验、再用真实反馈校准其权重与符号」这一机制，可能为 LVR 中注入 LLM 先验又不盲信、以及 latent 内容的贡献分配与校准提供可核查的方法线索；应用域与视觉推理无关。

title: MoE-Context: Show the Model Only What It Needs
summary: AI agents read their whole history at every step. People do not work like that: we keep what the moment needs and hold the rest as a rough note we can recall. MoE-Context applies this to language models. The context is split into blocks. Before each step a fast yes or no pass decides which blocks the step needs; the rest stay as one-line notes that can be brought back, and nothing is deleted. In the version we build, one model makes this decision and then answers, over a single key-value cache where hidden blocks are masked rather than removed. On a laptop with Qwen3-1.7B and a synthetic lookup task, showing only the needed block raises accuracy from 93 to 119 of 120, and a masked block is as hidden as a deleted one. The model's own picking is the weak part. A supervised linear probe written into spare output rows lifts its accuracy from 80 to 110 of 120, but simple keyword search picks perfectly on this task, and the probe does not transfer to a second task. We report these results openly, along with two cheap usage patterns that block switching enables: undoing a failed attempt and running subagents without a new context.

AI.brief_summary: 将上下文切成块，每一步先用一次快速的 yes/no 判断选出所需块，其余块压缩成一行可召回笔记而不删除，并在单一 KV cache 上用掩码而非移除来隐藏块；在小型模型与合成查询任务上评估，发现模型自主挑选是薄弱环节。
AI.relevance_reason: 块级「保留/隐藏」决策与 KV cache 掩码可供核查 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选及缓存、注意力结构对 latent 相似度的干扰；其学到的选择探针不迁移、关键词检索更强的负结果，也可能提示学习式证据选择的成本与局限。

title: Where Should a Diffusion Transformer Meet Its Teacher?
summary: Representation Alignment (REPA) significantly accelerates Diffusion Transformer training by guiding intermediate student features with a pretrained visual teacher, yet existing methods typically attach supervision to a single fixed layer. As student representations evolve, however, we find that the most effective layer for alignment varies across training stages. To track this evolving layer suitability online without costly search, we measure gradient compatibility between the flow-matching and alignment objectives, and propose AdaREPA, an online routing framework that adaptively selects the supervision layer as training progresses. AdaREPA uses a softmax distribution over smoothed layer compatibility scores to sample a layer for alignment at each training step. This probabilistic routing adapts teacher supervision to the student's changing learning needs, with minimal training overhead and no additional inference cost. On ImageNet-256, AdaREPA accelerates convergence and improves generation quality across model sizes, while revealing how the most suitable layers for supervision shift over training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究扩散 Transformer 的表示对齐应接在哪一层，发现最有效的对齐层会随训练阶段变化，于是提出 AdaREPA，用流匹配目标与对齐目标的梯度兼容性对平滑后的各层得分做 softmax 采样，在线选择监督层。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“监督层位置随训练动态变化、按梯度兼容性路由”的做法，可能为 LVR 训练中 latent 监督应加在何处、如何分配监督贡献提供可核查线索，也呼应表征相似度对深度与位置的敏感性；但任务属图像生成，迁移性待评估。

title: How to Turn an Attention Neural Network into an Interpretable Hard-Logic Predicate Circuit: Truth-Table Predicate Extraction and State-Machine Merging under Ship-of-Theseus Replacement
summary: We convert a trained attention network as a whole, attention included, into a hard-logic predicate circuit that runs in its place. Every unit of the circuit is a 0/1 predicate on tokens, and every map between predicates is a minimised truth table. Short tables, such as the product of a query code and a key code, are minimised exactly, and wide feature-to-feature transitions become implication rules by noise-tolerant minimisation. Blocks are replaced one at a time from the output down, in the manner of the Ship of Theseus, and after each replacement the remaining soft part re-adapts to the frozen circuit. Attention selection takes two forms, a row-wise comparison of integer scores (order selection) and a learned rule (rule selection). Both are fitted on the ordinary training set alone, and only on the examples that the teacher classifies correctly, so that the circuit imitates the teacher where the teacher is right. On TweetEval-emotion, the complete circuit of DistilGPT2 reaches a test gold accuracy of 66.5 $\pm$ 1.3% with order selection and 57.4 $\pm$ 2.5% with rule selection over three seeds, against 74.7% for the teacher and 64.0% for a bag of word pieces fitted on the same tweets, and that of BERT-base reaches 70.0 $\pm$ 0.5% with order selection and 63.7 $\pm$ 1.2% with rule selection against 77.8%. The circuit needs no multiplier and no weight traffic, and its exported hardware description reproduces it bit for bit. By a synthesis-based estimate it classifies one tweet in about 1-2 $μ$s (DistilGPT2) and 3-5 $μ$s (BERT) on an FPGA card and in 5-9 $μ$s on a palm-sized board whose module draws 7.5-15 W, two to three orders of magnitude faster than the network on a GPU at batch 1 (measured, 0.9-2.6 ms for DistilGPT2 including an optimised CUDA-graph baseline), at a cost of 8.5 (DistilGPT2) and 8.6 (BERT) points of gold accuracy for the synthesised seed-0 circuits.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把训练好的注意力网络整体（含注意力）自输出端逐块替换为 0/1 谓词电路，用最小化真值表和蕴含规则拟合，且只在教师分类正确的样本上训练，在 TweetEval-emotion 上验证了精度代价与 FPGA 推理速度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把注意力选择化为整数分数排序或学习规则、并以逐块替换冻结方式对齐行为的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中注意力对视觉证据的筛选能否离散化解释及贡献分配；但工作限于纯文本分类，与多模态推理状态的关联需核实。

title: Temporal Rank in Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) are a natural framework for temporal modelling, yet are often dismissed due to their sequential, non-parallelisable computation and difficulty in capturing long-range dependencies, typically attributed to vanishing and exploding gradients. We identify a distinct and under-explored limitation: an information bottleneck induced by rank-constrained hidden state dynamics, which limits the number of independent input directions that can be preserved over time, as reflected in the rank of the input-to-state mapping. We show that this constraint restricts temporal capacity independently of gradient stability. To address this, we introduce structured high-dimensional state dynamics that preserve temporal separability and prevent saturation of the input-to-state Jacobian over time. On controlled sequence tasks, the resulting model exhibits rapid learning despite remaining strictly within a standard RNN formulation. Our results demonstrate that RNN performance is governed by the evolution and preservation of temporal rank, and suggest that mitigating gradient pathologies alone is insufficient without explicitly maintaining temporal capacity.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出循环网络存在一个独立于梯度问题的瓶颈：隐藏状态动力学的低秩结构限制了输入到状态映射可长期保留的独立输入方向，即时间秩；并提出结构化高维状态动力学，使输入-状态雅可比随时间不饱和，从而在标准 RNN 框架内保持时间可分性并加快学习。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「状态秩饱和限制可保留信息方向」的诊断或可供核查循环式 latent 推理中多步状态更新的容量上限与信息坍缩，高维结构化状态动力学也可能为维持 latent 轨迹可分性提供线索，但原文仅涉及纯序列任务。

title: Reliable Tree Recruitment from Scarce Annotations for Forest Inventory Expansion
authors: Heitor Eduardo Ferreira Campos Morato Filpi
summary: Species-level inventories of individual tree crowns (ITCs) from UAV imagery are limited by annotation cost: in tropical forests, many species are represented by only a handful of field-validated crowns. We propose a reliable tree recruitment framework that expands a small annotated inventory by iteratively self-training a multi-task DeepLabV3 network, combining semantic segmentation with a crown-distance regression head, on RGB UAV orthomosaics. At each iteration, candidate crowns enter the training inventory only if they pass a confidence filter on class probability and distance map and a morphology filter on crown area and solidity, with at most five new crowns per species, keeping recruited samples consistent with the reference inventory. We evaluate the framework at two Brazilian sites: an Amazonian rainforest in Acre (17 species, 355 annotated crowns, 4 cm GSD) and a forest site in the Cerrado of Maranhão (4 species, 51 annotated crowns, 1.8 cm GSD). Over 20 iterations, the number of retained crowns grew from about 500 to 960 in Acre and from about 700 to over 3100 in Maranhão, while crown-level F1 exceeded single- and multi-task DeepLabV3 baselines (53.5% vs. 50.0% and 45.2%; 92.2% vs. 79.7% and 83.6%). The framework offers a low-cost route to expanding species inventories with consumer-grade UAVs and limited fieldwork.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 UAV 影像树种清单标注稀缺问题，提出迭代自训练的多任务 DeepLabV3 框架（语义分割＋冠幅距离回归），用类别概率与距离图置信过滤及面积、实心度形态过滤筛选新样本加入训练集，并在巴西两个站点评估扩充效果。

title: CaDO: Formal Verification-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Causal Dataset Repair and Generation
summary: High-quality causal reasoning datasets are essential for developing models with reliable causal understanding, particularly in specialized domains. However, existing datasets frequently suffer from incorrect annotations and structural imbalances, which can lead to biased predictions and limited generalization. To address this issue, we propose CaDO (Causal-Engine-Guided Multi-Agent Data Optimization), a multi-agent framework for automated diagnosis and repair of causal reasoning datasets. Our framework consists of three key stages: formal causal reasoning, multi-level diagnosis, and automated data repair and generation. First, a Formalizer Agent translates natural language questions into formal causal queries to minimize semantic deviations and make retrieval and verification more explicit and tractable. Second, a dual-level diagnosis mechanism employs independent Critic Agents to identify sample-level errors while analyzing query-type coverage and label distributions to detect dataset-level structural imbalances. Finally, the framework employs reusable repair operators grounded in formal causal semantics to correct erroneous samples, while Explorer and Expander Agent collaboratively produce diverse and semantically consistent new samples. Experimental results show that CaDO significantly outperforms the strongest of five data cleaning baselines in 16 out of 18 experimental settings, improving downstream model accuracy by up to 9.1%. Moreover, at least 95% of the samples flagged by CaDO are defective, and on CLadder, CaDO incorrectly modifies 92.2% fewer correct labels than an LLM-based judge, demonstrating its effectiveness and reliability. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/thisissyu/cado.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CaDO 多智能体框架，用 Formalizer Agent 将自然语言因果问题形式化为因果查询，再以双层 Critic 诊断样本级错误与数据集级结构失衡，最后用可复用修复算子和 Explorer/Expander 生成新样本，以提升因果推理数据集质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「形式化查询＋独立评判＋可复用修复算子」的数据诊断与修复流程，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹与监督标签的自动核查和筛选提供线索，但原文不涉及视觉输入或 latent 状态，迁移价值需核查。

title: Risk-Triggered Search: Behavior-Preserving Safe Control
summary: Pre-trained visual world models generate multi-step action plans from current and goal observations, yet terminal-proximity objectives fail to prevent forbidden-zone traversal or rigid-body collision sliding. Purely visual interfaces may lack analytical dynamics, structured states, or explicit collision geometry, requiring internal prediction of action-conditioned process risk. We propose Risk-Triggered Search (RTS) for frozen Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models. Rather than relying on static state features that cannot distinguish candidate plans sharing an observation, RTS unrolls action-conditioned future latent prefixes in the frozen world model and trains a lightweight risk head with process-violation supervision. To intervene selectively while preserving safe nominal behavior, RTS uses the same predicted prefix-risk criterion as both the search trigger gate and hard feasibility gate: safe nominal plans execute directly, whereas alarms trigger local Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) search to minimize nominal deviation within the feasible set. To prevent isotropic Euclidean minimal modification from shrinking obstacle-directed actions into zero-amplitude stalling, we introduce an amplitude-preserving metric $d_{\mathrm{AP}}$ that retains tangential progression while maintaining a unique zero at the nominal plan. Under unified gating and this unique-zero condition, bypassing safe-state search yields closed-loop trajectories strictly identical to every-step same-kernel search. Evaluated under a process-safety benchmark and Safe Arrival Rate (SAR) metric across five tasks, RTS improves SAR over Direct by 12.67--41.67 percentage points on navigation and articulated control and +2.08/+4.17 pp on Cube/PushT boundary cohorts, maintaining 100% action identity with every-step search while cutting controller time by 17.71%--70.41% across 1,968 paired trajectories.

title: Why Multi-Source Audio Fails to Compose: A Geometric Diagnosis and Its Remedy
summary: Multi-source audio-to-image generation exhibits consistent compositional failures when audio tokens occupy geometrically displaced, semantically unanchored positions in the CLIP text-token space, where the diffusion U-Net lacks the prior to reliably attend to them or ground them in distinct spatial regions. We formalize this as the geometric displacement phenomenon and expose it through a two-level clustering analysis comparing BEATs and CLAP embeddings at the raw encoder and projected CLIP token levels. Three geometric properties emerge as important: intra-class compactness, angular alignment with the CLIP text manifold, and inter-token spatial separation. We show that CLAP, whose contrastive language-audio pretraining aligns embeddings with natural language semantics, substantially outperforms BEATs on all three properties, improving the silhouette score by more than 3x and the Audio-Image Content score as well. Building on this analysis, we introduce a multi-token extension that requires no diffusion-backbone retraining and assigns each audio source to a distinct placeholder token in the CLIP tokenizer, complemented by a mixed inference-time objective that combines Attend-and-Excite with an A* spatial separation loss to resolve residual cross-token interference. For evaluation, we construct multi-audio compositional benchmarks from VGGSound (VGG2, VGG3, and VGGN) and extend six standard audio-image metrics to the multi-source setting. Across five benchmarks and four strong baselines, our method achieves strong results on the metrics most directly tied to compositional faithfulness, with AIC improvements of up to 2.25x over the strongest baseline and FID reduced by nearly 2x on two-source generation. We propose geometric displacement as a diagnostic framework for cross-modal generation systems that project learned embeddings into a pretrained contrastive space.

AI.brief_summary: 研究多源音频到图像生成的组合性失败，把原因归为音频 token 在 CLIP 文本 token 空间中发生几何位移、缺乏语义锚定，用两级聚类比较 BEATs 与 CLAP 的类内紧致性、与 CLIP 流形角对齐和 token 间空间分离度，并提出免重训的多占位符 token 方案与推理时 Attend-and-Excite 加 A* 空间分离损失的混合目标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「token 几何位置→注意力能否可靠定位」的诊断框架与三项几何度量可供核查 latent 视觉 token 是否被真正注意并使用，推理时注意力干预也可能为视觉证据筛选与贡献分配提供线索，但论文不涉及 VLM 推理或 latent 状态生成，迁移需另行验证。

title: MINT: Meeting-time Indicators for Truncation in Multi-Step Off-Policy RL
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 81 pages, 40 figures, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/seungyubhan/mint
summary: Many multi-step off-policy temporal-difference methods handle policy mismatch through products of per-step trace coefficients, leading to a trade-off between variance control and long-horizon signal. The maximum trace length consequently becomes a sensitive hyperparameter. We propose MINT (Meeting-time INdicators for Truncation), which replaces these products with a binary stopping indicator: one until coupled behavior and target trajectories first meet, zero thereafter. At the true value function, the indicator's idempotence yields a variance bound governed by meeting-time survival. For practical implementation, a single sampled action provides a model-free surrogate for the stopping rule, requiring no transition model or mixing-time estimate. We derive separate sufficient conditions for contraction of the state-coupled operator and its practical surrogate under fixed-policy evaluation. On MuJoCo and DeepMind Control tasks, MINT outperforms the reported multi-step baselines; the main MuJoCo comparison uses a common cap without per-task cap-length tuning. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of MINT on Atari 100k, RWRL, and OGBench experiments; MINT adapts the backup horizon to reduce target variability relative to long fixed-horizon backups across tasks and dynamics.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 MINT，用行为轨迹与目标轨迹首次相遇的二值停止指示替代多步 off-policy TD 中逐步迹系数的连乘，并给出方差界与收缩条件，在 MuJoCo、Atari 100k 等上验证自适应备份长度可降低目标方差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「相遇即截断」的自适应回撤长度与方差—长程信号权衡，可能为 latent/循环推理中如何确定 STOP 时机与截断监督视野提供可核查的线索，但不涉及视觉或多模态状态。

title: MLIE-CoT: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Multi-Level Image Editing
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has proven effective in improving the reasoning abilities of large language models by breaking complex tasks into step-by-step solutions. In recent years, researchers have attempted to extend CoT reasoning to visual generative models to improve their ability to handle complex tasks. However, existing CoT methods for text-to-image generation still rely mainly on textual reasoning and therefore cannot fully use and preserve the correct semantic information already present in an image, as even the most detailed language cannot capture all visual information. With advances in image generation, models such as FLUX and BAGEL can generate images conditioned on visual inputs. Recent work has attempted to carry images forward as context in the chain of thought, but this introduces another limitation: unsuitable earlier images can strongly interfere with the model, while repeated whole-image regeneration introduces new hallucinations at each round and causes them to accumulate. To address these issues, we propose MLIE-CoT, a visual chain-of-thought framework based on multi-level image editing. MLIE-CoT learns to select the repair granularity from three levels, preserving correct semantics whenever possible during reasoning while reducing the effect of incorrect content. To improve the ability of multimodal models to route errors of different severity to appropriate repair levels, we construct an image-repair dataset covering different error cases and use it to train a repair-level router. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MLIE-CoT significantly outperforms both its base models and methods using fixed repair strategies, producing clear improvements across multiple benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MLIE-CoT，将视觉思维链建模为多级图像编辑：从三种修复粒度中选择，尽量保留图像中已有的正确语义、削弱错误内容，并构建覆盖不同错误情况的图像修复数据集训练修复级路由器，在多个基准上超过基模型与固定修复策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 按错误严重程度路由编辑粒度的设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉状态的更新幅度、正确信息保留与逐轮幻觉累积抑制提供可供核查的方法线索；但该工作是文本到图像生成的视觉 CoT，不涉及 VLM 答案推理，迁移需自行判断。

title: Retroactive Concept Bottleneck Models for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Exemplar-free class-incremental learning (EFCIL) requires models to learn new classes sequentially without retaining training samples from previous tasks. Continual concept bottleneck models (CBMs) make their predictions interpretable by identifying visual concepts in an image and using them to score each class. However, these methods typically focus on preserving learned concepts or approximating past classes with generated features, which can leave new concepts underused in old-class predictions. We propose RetroCBM, which retains a small set of vocabulary-independent statistics relating frozen visual features to the embedding space of a pretrained vision-language model. Even after earlier training images have been discarded, we can use these statistics to supervise new concepts. To do so, we develop a retroactive regression rule that yields the same predictor for each new concept as class-balanced ridge regression on all images seen so far. We then reproject the stored statistics to recover the full-history squared classification loss and thus learn how much each new concept should contribute to old-class predictions. Since the classifier may use systematic concept errors to distinguish nearby classes, we further introduce a graph-weighted penalty on the margin shifts caused by those errors. Across six datasets, RetroCBM outperforms state-of-the-art interpretable methods in all class-incremental settings, with an 18.1\% relative gain in mean average incremental accuracy over the strongest exemplar-free baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RetroCBM，在无样本类增量学习中仅保留一组与词表无关的统计量，记录冻结视觉特征与预训练 VLM 嵌入空间之间的关系，并设计回溯回归规则使新概念获得与全历史类平衡岭回归一致的预测器，再重投影统计量恢复全历史分类损失以学习新概念对旧类预测的贡献，另加图加权惩罚抑制系统性概念误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 概念瓶颈以可解释概念作为中间决策状态，其「用少量充分统计量在不保留图像时继续监督新概念并衡量其对旧类贡献」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中视觉概念证据的保留、增量更新与贡献分配问题。

title: ShoWorld: Shape-Faithful Multi-Hypothesis Occupancy World Model
summary: Occupancy world models struggle to forecast moving objects due to motion uncertainty and shape distortion. A single trajectory can average plausible futures into an implausible path, and repeated re-voxelization can erode or inflate object shape even under correct motion. We introduce ShoWorld to address these challenges through separate motion and shape representations. The motion forecaster predicts probabilistic trajectories conditioned on scene layout, nearby agents and the future ego trajectory. Each hypothesis is rendered into occupancy and fused according to its probability to retain alternative futures. The shape component predicts sub-voxel points with occupancy probabilities and offsets from local geometry. These points move rigidly with the object, and voxel occupancy follows the probability that at least one occupied point falls within it. This representation reduces shape distortion under motion. ShoWorld achieves state-of-the-art results on Occ3D-nuScenes. With ground-truth occupancy and ego trajectory, it improves mIoU and IoU by 6.56 and 9.16 points overall and by 6.06 and 5.53 points on dynamic classes.

AI.brief_summary: ShoWorld 是面向自动驾驶的占据世界模型，将「运动」与「形状」解耦：运动模块在场景布局与自车轨迹条件下预测多条概率化轨迹并按概率融合渲染占据，形状模块以带占据概率和偏移的 sub-voxel 点随物体刚性运动，以缓解多模态未来平均与重复体素化造成的形状失真。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按概率保留多种未来假设的融合方式与 sub-voxel 点表示刚性携带几何，或可为 LVR 中多种 latent 假设的维护和几何细节在状态更新中的保真提供方法借鉴，但属于 3D 占据预测，需核查能否用于 VLM 内部状态。

title: Anchoring with Visual Evidence: Explicit Semantic Anchors for Joint Change Detection and Captioning
summary: Joint change detection and captioning seeks to localize changes and describe them from bi-temporal remote sensing images. A key challenge is translating dense visual evidence into the semantic conditions that guide description generation. We propose Explicit Semantic Anchors (ESA), a supervised interface that exposes entity presence, temporal appearance variation, and spatial extent. A prediction-guided readout combines visual features and predicted change probabilities, and three factor heads estimate the corresponding anchor activations. These activations guide generation through two complementary routes. The context route maps the three factor activations to three separate memory tokens, one per factor, and appends them to the dense visual memory, while the lexicon route produces an additive vocabulary bias at each decoding step. Dense visual memory remains available for spatial detail and information beyond the explicit factors. Anchor targets are derived from existing images and change annotations, requiring no additional anchor-level language annotation. At inference, all conditions are computed from the input image pair and the model's own predictions. Experiments on LEVIR-MCI and WHU-CDC show strong joint detection and captioning performance, supporting the use of supervised visual attributes as explicit conditions for change description generation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Explicit Semantic Anchors（ESA），用监督方式显式暴露实体存在、时序外观变化与空间范围三类锚点，经预测引导读出后以记忆 token 和词汇偏置两条路径条件化双时相遥感图像的联合变化检测与描述生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「将稠密视觉证据压缩为少量显式因子并注入生成」的接口，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、latent 内容是否真正被答案使用以及视觉旁路/信息坍缩等问题，但任务本身不是推理期 latent 状态生成。

title: Latent Action Policies from Suboptimal Data
summary: Latent Action Models (LAMs) learn control representations from action-free video, but existing pipelines typically train latent policies with behavioral cloning, without an explicit policy improvement objective. Although offline RL offers a natural approach to policy improvement, standard methods do not transfer directly to learned latent action spaces. We find that the structure of learned latent actions makes naive offline RL unreliable: directly maximizing value over latent actions or fitting a unimodal policy can produce latent actions that cannot be realized by physical execution, while the latent representation can merge physical controls that receive different rewards. To understand when latent-space optimization remains valid, we derive conditions under which policy improvement transfers to decoded execution and under which latent and physical optima align. Building on these insights, we propose LAPIS for goal-conditioned latent policy improvement, grounding value-based policy improvement in observed state-latent transitions and using a conditional flow policy to capture their multimodal structure. LAPIS outperforms baselines on most tasks, with the clearest gains in visual manipulation, and remains effective even with only 1% action labels, where competing methods largely collapse.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究如何在无动作视频学得的 latent action 空间中用离线 RL 做策略改进：指出直接在 latent 上最大化价值或拟合单峰策略会产生物理不可执行的动作，且 latent 可能合并奖励不同的控制，据此推导策略改进可迁移到解码执行的条件，并提出基于条件 flow policy 的 LAPIS。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对 latent 表示合并异质控制、latent 最优与解码后最优何时对齐的分析，可能为 LVR 中「latent 状态优化能否对应有效推理步骤」及 latent 多峰分布、信息坍缩问题提供可供核查的线索，但论文属机器人控制场景，联系需较多迁移判断。

title: Comparing Each Generation with Independent Siblings Gives Video World Model Post-Training a Proper Objective for Outcome Frequencies
summary: Video world models are used as simulators, so when a first frame leaves several physical outcomes open, repeated generations should produce each outcome as often as it occurs in the data. Physics post-training scores every generation against the single recorded future of its history, which makes single videos more faithful, but the expected score is linear in the model distribution and is maximized by always producing the most likely outcome. The log-likelihood of the recorded outcome is maximized by the data distribution, and its gradient weights agreement with the record by the inverse of how often the model produces the generated outcome, a frequency that other generations of the same history with independent noise, its siblings, can estimate. To train with this weight from a finite group, we propose SibPO, which performs Sibling-paired Policy Optimization: siblings estimate a truncated inverse-frequency weight for agreement with the record, and a second term subtracts the same weight times the agreement with the siblings, which makes the expected objective a strictly proper divergence over outcome cells at every group size. On PisaBench, SibPO lowers the KS distance to simulated landing times by 9.1-10.2% relative to the strongest method outside its reward family on three of four video models without degrading single videos, and it lowers the error of estimated robot policy success rates by 13%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对视频世界模型的物理后训练，指出对单一记录未来打分会使期望分数随模型分布线性变化、被最可能结果占优，提出 SibPO：用同史独立噪声的兄弟样本估计截断逆频率权重，使目标在每个组规模下都成为对结果格的严格 proper 散度，并在 PisaBench 上降低着陆时间 KS 距离与策略成功率估计误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单条记录监督导致分布坍缩」的诊断与兄弟样本逆频率加权，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 轨迹或假设采样的贡献分配与训练目标提供可核查线索，但需先判断该机制能否迁移到推理状态监督。

title: Fuse Before Reconstruct: A Novel Reconstruction Paradigm for Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection
comment: Preprint before peer review. Includes supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/LiZhi-CASIA/FBR
summary: Industrial anomaly detection plays a pivotal role in precision manufacturing, where joint analysis of multimodal data emerges as a critical approach to enhance detection accuracy. Feature reconstruction, a dominant paradigm for such joint analysis, is primarily implemented through intra-modal and cross-modal methods, both of which are plagued by significant limitations. Intra-modal reconstruction neglects complementary cross-modal information, while its cross-modal counterpart is prone to projection errors and ambiguous one-to-many mappings (e.g., same textures mapping to multiple geometries), leading to detection failures. To address these limitations, we propose a novel feature reconstruction paradigm, Fuse Before Reconstruct (FBR), which first fuses multimodal features and then performs reconstruction for anomaly detection. Firstly, we propose a bidirectional cross-modal attention mechanism to achieve deep feature complementarity between image and point cloud features, mitigating projection bias through channel alignment and dynamic spatial prior integration. Besides, a learnable pixel-wise gated fusion strategy is adopted to preserve multi-modal structural consistency while optimizing local feature combination. Finally, dual-path collaborative reconstruction is implemented to recover original modal features from the fused representations, where cross-modal consistency constraints effectively eliminate mapping ambiguities. Extensive experiments show that FBR achieves 98.3% I-AUROC on MVTec 3D-AD and 92.6% I-AUROC on Eyecandies, surpassing previous state-of-the-art methods by +2.9% and +4.1%, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「先融合再重建」（FBR）的多模态工业异常检测范式：以双向跨模态注意力对齐图像与点云特征，经像素级门控融合后由双路径重建原模态特征，并用跨模态一致性约束缓解一对多映射歧义。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「融合表征能否重建出模态特有细节」的设计，或可作为检验 LVR 内部状态是否发生视觉信息坍缩的探针，跨模态一致性约束也可能提示证据保真度评价方式；但该工作属工业异常检测，不含推理期 latent 状态生成，可借鉴性需较多核查。

title: NaviGATE: Noise-Aware Dual-View Generation for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Multimodal knowledge graph reasoning (MKGR) aims to infer missing facts by jointly exploiting relational structures, textual descriptions, and visual evidence. Existing embedding-based methods effectively capture graph topology, but their fixed multimodal representations are less effective for query-specific fine-grained semantic reasoning, while generation-based methods are vulnerable to noisy retrieval and may produce invalid entities. To address these challenges, we propose NaviGATE, a noise-aware generative framework for MKGR. NaviGATE first aligns graph-derived structural representations with textual semantics, then performs structure-aware internal knowledge activation by fine-tuning the multimodal language model with multimodal entity summaries and injected structural tokens. In the noise-aware dual-view instruction tuning stage, NaviGATE jointly optimizes retrieval-free and retrieval-aware views: reliable retrieved candidates are reinforced through contrastive logit sharpening, while misleading candidates are suppressed through parametric consistency distillation. In inference, structure-constrained decoding restricts generation to valid entities in the target knowledge graph. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that NaviGATE consistently outperforms strong unimodal, multimodal, and generation-based baselines, and remains robust under noisy retrieval scenarios.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 NaviGATE 多模态知识图谱补全生成框架：先对齐图结构与文本语义并注入结构 token 激活内部知识，再用检索无关/检索感知双视角指令微调，通过对比 logit 锐化强化可靠候选、蒸馏抑制误导候选，最后以结构约束解码保证实体合法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其区分可靠与误导检索证据的双视角训练及合法答案约束解码，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与受限生成的处理线索；但论文核心是多模态 KG 补全性能，未分析内部 latent 表示或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 机制，迁移需自行判断。

title: Beyond Appearance: Evidence-Guided Programmatic 3D Scene Reconstruction with Agentic Lighting Reasoning
summary: Image-to-code methods for 3D scene reconstruction produce executable code that generates editable digital content and supports visual simulation. However, existing methods primarily rely on appearance similarity, which provides limited guidance for distinguishing errors in geometry, materials, and illumination. Light shapes scene appearance through its interactions with geometry and materials, influencing shading, cast shadows, and reflections. We therefore present LightHarness, a VLM-based agentic framework that incorporates explicit lighting reasoning into iterative scene reconstruction. To be specific, we leverage complementary geometric, intrinsic, and illumination cues to jointly refine scene structure and appearance, and propose Lighting Reasoning Memory to maintain light-source hypotheses, which supports evidence, and revision history throughout iterations. Together, they support reasoning about partially visible and unseen sources, with evidence-guided verification directing subsequent revisions. Our framework reconstructs explicit scenes through coherent reasoning about geometry, materials, and illumination without additional training or differentiable rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior image-to-code reconstruction accuracy under challenging shadows and complex illumination, further supporting downstream scene editing, object insertion, and versatile relighting.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LightHarness，一个基于 VLM 的 agentic 框架，将显式光照推理引入迭代式 image-to-code 3D 场景重建，联合几何、本征与光照线索精修场景，并用 Lighting Reasoning Memory 维护光源假设与修订历史。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「假设记忆＋证据引导验证」可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、迭代状态维护与停止决策提供方法线索，但输出为显式代码，未涉及内部 latent 推理状态，需核查其验证与修订机制的可迁移性。

title: ALIVE: Bring Foundation Features to Life with Events
summary: Visual foundation models provide powerful representations for diverse tasks, but their features become stale as visual content changes between image observations. Refreshing them requires new frames and repeated runs of a computationally expensive image encoder. We introduce ALIVE, an event-based method that incrementally updates native foundation model features between image observations. Given an anchor image, ALIVE uses subsequent events to transport and correct existing multi-layer features extracted by a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Its lightweight updater is trained end-to-end using only synthetic data, without downstream task supervision, and transfers directly to real-world event streams without any adaptation. Across three real-world datasets and five task-dataset settings spanning object detection, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation, ALIVE outperforms all evaluated event-based methods in every metric. On DSEC, when the anchor frame is 200,ms old, ALIVE improves over anchor-image predictions by 30.9,mAP in detection, 11.6,mIoU in segmentation, and 15.9% in depth AbsRel. Compared with image re-encoding, ALIVE reduces FLOPs by 82.4% and latency by a factor of 2.5.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ALIVE，利用两次图像观测之间的事件流，将冻结 DINOv3 编码器已提取的多层特征进行搬运与校正，并用纯合成数据端到端训练一个轻量更新器，从而无需重跑图像编码器即可增量刷新视觉特征。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结编码器 + 轻量增量更新」维持视觉特征新鲜度的做法，可能为 LVR 中在不重复昂贵视觉编码的前提下持续更新内部视觉状态、以及动态计算成本核算提供可核查线索；但依赖事件相机输入，与推理/答案使用环节的联系尚待判断。

title: From Activity Recognition to Shift Detection: Variational Wi-Fi Sensing with Evidential Uncertainty
summary: Human motion perturbs wireless channels, making commodity Wi-Fi devices a practical platform for device-free activity recognition. Yet Channel State Information (CSI) also depends strongly on the person, receiver position, recording session, and surrounding environment, so a classifier can continue producing activity labels after its deployment conditions have moved away from those seen during training. We propose Wi-HAR, a multi-antenna architecture in which four Variational Auto-Encoders learn compact distributions from raw Wi-Fi 6 CSI magnitudes and a delayed-fusion classifier combines their means and log-variances. On twelve activities from a public benchmark, Wi-HAR reaches 96.6% median recognition accuracy, compared with 70.8-81.5% for independently optimized single-antenna models, showing that the antennas provide complementary views of the same activity. We then use the same latent backbone to detect deployment shifts without using shifted samples for model selection or calibration. A class-conditional uncertainty score derived from Evidential Deep Learning achieves a macro-average ROC-AUC of 0.897 across eleven datasets that change receiver position, participant, recording session, or room, and detects 82.5% of shifted samples at a realized 5.2% in-distribution rejection rate. Detection performance nevertheless varies substantially across receiver positions, showing that the same physical change does not induce a uniform uncertainty response. The compact representation also supports shallow decision-tree analysis using variables from several antennas.
